name: Quad9 (DNS-over-HTTPS, RFC 8484 wire format)
tier_rationale: Established security non-profit with published terms and privacy policy (A8 BR2); allowed resolver by council decision (P029 cond 6), reached only through the no-ECS endpoint dns.quad9.net.

reliability.justification: Threat-blocking resolver: names it blocks as malicious are answered NXDOMAIN, so its NXDOMAIN is confirmed by a second resolver before any 'does not exist' decision (P029 cond 10).

doh.title: DNS-over-HTTPS wire-format answers (dns.quad9.net/dns-query, via the optional dnspython extra)

terms.quote: Default resolvers are limited to providers whose terms allow business use, recorded with evidence in the provider registry (Google Public DNS, Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Quad9; tier trusted).

doh.notes: Quote: binding council text (P029 cond 6). RFC 8484 only through no-ECS endpoints (dns.quad9.net, not dns11).

notes: Owned by core (WP02); provider_id of the 'quad9' resolver of core/dns.py (not a default resolver).
